name: Ancien des routes de clan
description: A lean weathered elderly chief with pale olive skin, a long old scar on one side of the head, four asymmetrical natural mandible tusks and swept-back grey dreads with a handful of copper cuffs. Burnished bronze ceremonial breastplate over rust-orange cloth, long split charcoal robe and fitted wraps. Carries a folded dark cloth standard rolled around a short rod across both forearms. No loose floor props.
